uploadProfile.note: QA observation of original native GL, renderer.initTexture and loaded skeleton.computeBoneTexture calls only. Setup retrieves the existing context once without GL queries, draws, reads, allocations or uploads of its own.

note: Explicit in-memory8851 QA. Each A/B/A arm uses a newly constructed original256 NPC rig/context and the same locally loaded model. Shader mode compares unprepared/compiled/unprepared. Textures mode compares shader-only/original-texture-preupload-plus-shader/shader-only; ALL arms normalize fresh state through the same public resetState path and compile the actual subject before first draw. Preupload uses original map/alphaMap identities, without cloning or needsUpdate. It normalizes private/public state for subsequent Three draw, not an exact restoration of past GL texture binding. GLB load is completed in all arms and excluded from preparation/combat clocks. This is a fresh renderer context comparison, not hardware/driver-cold proof. Preparation/upload/shader/first native render/whole fixed1/60 batch8 combat are separate. API submission/readiness does not prove GPU completion, link success, uniform/geometry/VAO/bone work or elimination of first read waits. No product catch-up/HUD/audio/save/FPS/GPU-execution or real-memory claim. Original GL upload/reflection/buffer/VAO/bone calls are only observed; nested inclusive wall times must not be added. Normal game rules/state/events are compared; source audit scope is recorded per pass. Every combat pass requires native submission/selection and no observed rig error. Shared main-renderer player/background caches can vary. Product load/preload remains unchanged; candidate is QA-only.
